cards.card_text: So the Pharisees’ disciples and the Herodians, supporters of King Herod’s family, walk up and lay it on THICK: “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.” Friend, that’s a coworker telling you you’re the smartest person in the building right before asking you to cover their Saturday shift.
